title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI | TechCrunch
summary: Recursive’s automated research system, which it calls the Eureka Machine, helped with nearly every step of Flint’s development, the company says. Recursive says each new model should make the Eureka Machine a better researcher, helping it build the next one faster.
